label: EU digital and cyber resilience
summary: Onboarding settles which EU regime the entity falls under and in which class (DORA entity type and size class, NIS2 sector, size and entity class, member states); registers, governance, supplier lists and incident reporting are the compliance work that follows.

source.ref: DORA Art. 2 (financial entities in scope), Art. 16 (simplified framework) and Art. 26 (threat-led testing); NIS2 Arts 2 and 3 (sectors, size rule, essential and important entities), Art. 26 (jurisdiction) and Art. 27 (registry)

fields.label: Entity type
fields.note: DORA Art. 2 lists the financial entities in scope, from banks and insurers to crypto-asset providers and pension funds. The type decides the competent authority and whether a simplified regime can apply. Pick the closest.

fields.label: Size class
fields.note: Art. 16 gives a simplified framework only to the small categories it names, not to any small firm. Microenterprises stay on the full framework with some relief (for example Art. 5(3)). Confirm the class with the authority.

fields.label: TLPT status
fields.note: Art. 26: entities the authority designates carry out threat-led penetration testing, normally every three years. Record whether the entity has been told. The selection criteria are the authority's, not the entity's.

fields.label: Sector

source.ref: Commission NIS2 page and FAQ: 18 critical sectors in Annexes I and II; medium and large entities in them are in scope

fields.note: NIS2 covers 18 critical sectors in Annexes I and II. Medium and large entities in them are in scope, and some entity types are in scope whatever their size (Art. 2). Pick the closest and check the national law.

fields.label: Sub-sector
fields.note: Sub-sector or entity type as named in the annex. The national registration and the competent authority depend on it.

fields.label: Size class

source.ref: Commission NIS2 FAQ: size threshold rule; Member States may add smaller entities with a high risk profile

fields.note: NIS2 applies a size threshold: medium and large entities in the listed sectors are in scope, and Member States may add smaller high-risk ones (Commission FAQ). Pick the class that applies to this entity.

fields.label: Entity class

source.ref: Commission NIS2 FAQ: essential and important entities, supervision regime and minimum fine ceilings

fields.note: Essential or important decides the supervision regime and the fine ceiling (at least EUR 10m or 2% for essential, EUR 7m or 1.4% for important). Each Member State confirms the class under its own law.

source.ref: NIS2 Art. 26 (jurisdiction: main establishment, entities outside the Union) and the Commission transposition page; DORA register of information (EBA preparation page and FAQ, 28 March 2025) for the register fields

fields.label: Member states

source.ref: National transposition laws (not individually checked); Commission transposition page

fields.note: EU countries where the entity is established or serves. Each has its own national law, authority and register, so the class can differ by country. National laws were not individually checked (unverified).

fields.label: Main establishment

source.ref: Commission NIS2 FAQ and Art. 26: listed digital entities fall under the country of their main EU establishment

fields.note: DNS, TLD, cloud, data centre, CDN, managed service and security providers, marketplaces, search engines and social networks fall under the country of their main EU establishment (Art. 26). Others follow where they are established.

fields.label: Outside the EU

source.ref: Commission NIS2 FAQ and Art. 26: entities not established in the Union designate a representative

fields.note: Tick when the entity is not established in the EU but offers services there. Listed entity types in that position fall under Art. 26 and the country where they designate a representative.

fields.label: Critical ICT providers
fields.note: Whether any ICT provider is a critical third-party provider designated by the European Supervisory Authorities.

fields.label: Authority
fields.note: The competent authority that supervises the entity, if known.

fields.label: Registered
fields.note: Whether the entity is registered with its national authority as NIS2 requires. Some states have not opened registration yet.

fields.label: Authority
fields.note: The competent authority or CSIRT the entity reports to, if known.

gate.label: The DORA entity type is decided
gate.hint: Check Art. 2 and pick the entity type, or record that the entity is not an Article 2 entity.

gate.label: The entity is an Article 2 entity
gate.hint: DORA applies to the financial entities Art. 2 lists; if the entity is not one, check whether this framework is needed.

gate.label: The NIS2 entity class is decided
gate.hint: Decide essential, important or not in scope from the sector and size.

gate.label: Sector and class agree
gate.hint: A sector outside NIS2 gives a voluntary use; confirm the class or change the sector.
